Nearly 40% of investors expect the market to fall over the next six months, according to the latest weekly survey from the American Association of Individual Investors, while around 35% are bullish and 25% are neutral. If these factors create a perfect storm for a market downturn, history still has good news for investors. ## Will the stock market crash in 2026? A higher percentage suggests the market is more richly valued, and Warren Buffett -- who popularized the metric in 2001 -- noted that when it nears 200%, investors are "playing with fire." As of August 2026, the Buffett indicator sits at a record high of nearly 238%.

U.S. stocks settled higher on Wednesday, with the Dow Jones index gaining almost 300 points during the session. On the economic data front, ADP showed private payrolls rose just 38,000 in August, the weakest since January and below the 47,000 consensus, while July factory orders climbed 0.9% versus the 0.6% expected.
